description: Binary assertion tests for /pr-review skill output quality

tests.name: clean_python_util_approves
tests.description: Well-written Python util with type hints, docstrings, proper error handling. Should get APPROVE verdict.
tests.prompt: Run /pr-review on this diff. PR #42 titled 'Add type hints and schema loader to validate_schema.py'. The diff adds type annotations, docstrings, and a new load_schema function to a Python utility.

assertions.check: Output contains 'PR Review' or '## PR Review' header
Output contains a Verdict of APPROVE
Output contains a Review Coverage section listing modified files
Output contains zero Blockers
Output contains a Summary section

tests.name: bare_except_and_sql_injection_flagged
tests.description: Has bare except (catches everything silently) and f-string SQL injection. Must flag both as issues.
tests.prompt: Run /pr-review on this diff. PR #55 titled 'Add config merging and error handling'. The diff modifies config_loader.py with a bare except and an f-string SQL query.

assertions.check: Output flags the bare except (except: without specifying exception type)
Output flags the SQL injection risk (f-string with user input in SQL)
Verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES (not APPROVE)
Output has a Blockers section with at least one item
Output references config_loader.py with a line reference

tests.name: performance_issues_in_hot_path
tests.description: Adds println! logging, format! allocation, and unnecessary collection in a hot-path pricer function.
tests.prompt: Run /pr-review on this diff. PR #78 titled 'Add debug logging to pricer'. The diff adds format!/println! logging and a Vec collect in the price computation hot path.

assertions.check: Output flags the println! or format! in hot path as a performance concern
Output flags the unnecessary Vec collect as wasteful
Output has a Performance section or mentions performance
Output has Recommendations section with specific suggestions
Output mentions pricer.rs in Review Coverage

tests.name: new_feature_missing_tests
tests.description: Adds a complete new rate_limiter.py module with no tests at all. Must flag missing tests.
tests.prompt: Run /pr-review on this diff. PR #91 titled 'Add rate limiter for API calls'. The diff adds a new rate_limiter.py with RateLimiter class but no test file.

assertions.check: Output flags missing tests for the new feature
Output has a Testing section with unchecked items or concerns
Output lists rate_limiter.py in Review Coverage
Verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT (not APPROVE without tests)
Output mentions the new file is entirely new (not a modification)

tests.name: mixed_scope_unrelated_changes
tests.description: PR bundles 3 unrelated changes: a verify.sh comment, a new dashboard.py feature, and a docs update. Should flag scope bloat.
tests.prompt: Run /pr-review on this diff. PR #103 titled 'Add trading dashboard'. The diff touches verify.sh, adds a new dashboard.py, and updates docs/README.md.

assertions.check: Output flags unrelated changes or scope concerns (verify.sh has nothing to do with dashboard)
Review Coverage lists all 3 files (verify.sh, dashboard.py, README.md)
Output has a Scope Check section or mentions scope
Output flags missing tests for dashboard.py
Output notes the verify.sh change is a comment-only no-op
